er_v06_c01_b005_01: That's all? In the upper district this would buy two portions.
er_v06_c01_b005_02: I can see that. The goods are from the lower levels. The prices are upper-district.
er_v06_c01_b006_01: What? You don't even have food? And you call this a shop?
er_v06_c01_b006_02: Unbelievable... Fine. I'll look somewhere else.
er_v06_c02_b003_01: Same price you quoted. Fine, I'll take these.
er_v06_c02_b005_01: The same goods cost more here than anywhere else?
er_v06_c02_b005_02: This is my first time living in the lower levels. It doesn't mean I can't do arithmetic!
er_v06_c02_b006_01: Forget it. I'll look around. There must be more than one shop down here.
er_v06_c03_b003_01: Less than I thought. But the price is fair.
er_v06_c03_b004_02: It'd better be useful. Don't let me come back and find them still here, like they're waiting for pity.
er_v06_c03_b006_01: Fine, I'll take them. If you won't buy, someone else will.
er_v06_c04_b001_01: Hello there. You know Eleanor, don't you? I'm her... uncle.
er_v06_c04_b001_02: We prepared a little gift for her. Only the best from the upper district.
er_v06_c04_b001_03: But I can't find her anywhere.
er_v06_c04_b001_04: Young people get upset and hide. I hear she comes here often.
er_v06_c04_b001_05: Next time she visits, could you give this to her?
er_v06_c04_b001_06: Make sure it reaches her hands. Not yours. Hers.
er_v06_c04_b001_07: If anyone asks, you never saw me.
er_v06_c04_b001_08: Oh, and keep Security out of this. It's a family matter.
er_v06_c04_b002_01: Good. Put it in her hands, not yours. I'll know.
er_v06_c04_b005_01: The crate was reported stolen. He's the one who reported it.
er_v06_c04_b005_02: He left me a crate? One that was reported stolen?
er_v06_c04_b005_03: They wanted me arrested. Just like my mother.
er_v06_c04_b006_01: The crate was reported stolen, and it's still in my storeroom. Don't touch it.
er_v06_c04_b006_02: A 'gift' that was reported stolen... They wanted me arrested. Just like my mother.
er_v06_c04_b009_01: I'll come back when I've sorted out my thoughts.
er_v06_c05_b005_02: Me begging you for food. And me apologising.
er_v06_c05_b006_01: Don't tell anyone I came here to beg today.
er_v06_c05_b006_02: Thank you. There aren't many things I can still decide for myself. Let me keep this one.
er_v06_c05_b007_01: Don't move! That crate was reported stolen.
er_v06_c05_b007_02: What? It's not mine! I've never seen it before!
er_v06_c05_b007_03: Like mother, like daughter. Come with us.
er_v06_c05_b007_04: Please, someone set me up! Shopkeeper, tell them!
er_v06_c05_b008_01: You're the one who set them straight, aren't you? They rechecked the theft report.
er_v06_c05_b008_02: I said it over and over in there. The crate wasn't mine.
er_v06_c05_b008_03: One of the officers laughed. He said my mother said the same thing.
er_v06_c05_b008_04: I'm out. She's still in there.
er_v06_c05_b009_01: You were tricked too. ...But next time, ask me first. All right?
er_v06_c05_b010_01: You knew it was reported stolen?
er_v06_c05_b010_03: Then don't act as if getting me out makes it never happen.
er_v06_c11_b003_01: I can pay. But from now on, you listen to me.
er_v06_c11_b003_02: Put the business terms in writing. Whether I take the loan is my decision.
er_v06_c11_b003_05: My mother didn't teach me to pay a debt with myself. That's not how it works down here either.
er_v06_c11_b005_01: The last part of the shortfall, I was planning to cover with the locket.
er_v06_c11_b005_02: It's been hanging on me doing nothing. Now I want it to help me find my mother.
er_v06_c11_b005_03: I have. Price it like anything else.
er_v06_c12_b004_01: People come and go here every day. It'll be safer with you.
er_v06_c12_b004_02: All right. We agree on who it goes to first. No changing our minds at the last minute.
er_v06_c13_b001_01: That crate last time. Remember me?
er_v06_c13_b002_01: Surprised? I'm out again. Someone sorted the paperwork. Some things aren't as hard as you think.
er_v06_c13_b003_01: Boss, I have a message. About Eleanor and the research disk she has.
er_v06_c13_b005_01: Boss, you'd better think carefully. The record will show your part too.
er_v06_c13_b005_02: Then write it all down. Don't just write hers.
er_v06_c13_b006_01: Message delivered. Tell her to come talk when she's decided.
er_v06_c14_b002_01: Apply for temporary custody first, then talk about reopening the case. The records of the frame-up and threats, plus the research, prove she's in danger and what their motive is.
er_v06_c14_b002_02: I'll prepare her identity papers and medical history. I know what medication she used to take.
er_v06_c14_b003_01: I don't have a way to get her out right now.
er_v06_c14_b003_02: Then we negotiate their release terms first. I can't gamble with my mother's life.
er_v06_c14_b004_01: If someone takes over her protection, I want to know who's responsible and when I can see her.
er_v06_c14_b004_02: And don't go see that enforcer alone.
er_v06_c14_b004_03: I'm already waiting for one person to come out of there. I don't want to wait for another.
er_v06_c14_b005_01: Bring your mother back first. Return the research.
er_v06_c14_b005_02: You're right. She's my only family.
er_v06_c14_b005_03: But I need to see them release her with my own eyes. Not just move her from one cell to another.
er_v06_c14_b006_01: Secure the transfer and protection first. Once she's safe, we decide who gets the research.
er_v06_c14_b006_02: All right. I'll organize her files. Tell me what you need. Don't finish everything alone and only then tell me.
er_v06_c14_b007_01: If we publish it, everyone will know what they did. But I cannot promise your mother will survive.
er_v06_c14_b007_02: I know they mean it. ...Give me a moment.
er_v06_c14_b007_03: They won't even say where to pick her up. If I hand over the drive and they change the terms, what do I have to bargain with?
er_v06_c14_b007_04: I want her back, and I'm afraid they'll erase the research she spent so long on.
er_v06_c15_b003_01: Your part is in the application too.
er_v06_c15_b003_02: I checked your shop address twice.
er_v06_c15_b003_03: Afraid that if something happens, I wouldn't be able to find you.
er_v06_c15_b003_04: You're here. That's why I dared to take it this far.
er_v06_c15_b004_01: The safety review for the person concerned has been accepted. Transfer to temporary protective custody approved; family may visit after verification. This measure does not mean the original case is dismissed.
er_v06_c15_b004_03: All right. I'll go now. Verify first, then see her.
er_v06_c15_b004_04: If it's real, I'll come back and tell you. In person.
er_v06_c15_b005_01: Verify the person and the paperwork first. Don't just take a messenger's word that it's done.
er_v06_c15_b005_02: I want my mother to confirm it herself. Someone else reading a line for her doesn't count.
er_v06_c15_b005_03: No copy. If I'm trading it for her, I can't use her life as collateral and gamble that they won't find out.
er_v06_c15_b005_04: I've thought it through. Whether there's another way later is a later problem.
er_v06_c15_b005_05: Today, I just want to see her.
er_v06_c15_b006_01: Still no confirmation that she can be released, right?
er_v06_c15_b006_02: No. Keep applying, or switch to handing over the drive for her release.
er_v06_c15_b006_03: I don't want to treat 'processing' as if she's already safe. Get her out first.
er_v06_c16_b001_02: I saw her myself! The first thing she asked was whether I'd been skipping meals again.
er_v06_c16_b001_03: She was exiled to the lower levels. She can't go back to her old farm.
er_v06_c16_b001_04: But we're together again. Tonight, I know where she's sleeping.
er_v06_c16_b002_01: I saw Mother! She's been moved out, someone's watching over her, and the visit is registered.
er_v06_c16_b002_02: She knows what comes next. The research, the threats, going public. I told her everything.
er_v06_c16_b002_03: She said to let the protection staff confirm the arrangements first, then send the material out.
er_v06_c16_b002_04: She said I'm reckless enough for both of us. Someone in the family has to ask more questions.
er_v06_c16_b004_01: The research on restoring nutrifruit seeds has been handed to independent researchers for verification. The representative of Pastel's station office is suspected of coercion and interference in the case and is now under investigation.
er_v06_c16_b004_02: The person concerned is currently under registered protection. The original embezzlement case is still under review; the investigation result does not constitute a final ruling.
er_v06_c16_b005_01: The registered protection arrangements have been confirmed. The family is permitted to register a residence in the lower levels and live together, and may carry on normal daily activities. Contact person and address are on file; contact must be maintained during the review of the original case.
er_v06_c17_b004_01: The material has been sent out. I'll keep cooperating with the review. The rest will take time, step by step.
er_v06_c17_b004_02: You were right to get me transferred before publishing. The people with the least protection shouldn't always be the ones paying the price.
er_v06_c17_b005_01: That's all. Don't refuse to take my money just because it's me.
er_v06_c17_b005_02: She won't take things for free. That part is certainly like me.
er_v06_c17_b005_03: When she talks about this place lately, it's not just about what she bought.
er_v06_c17_b005_04: And whatever else she said, go ask her yourself. I won't finish her sentences.
er_v06_c18_b001_02: She did. Bought some things, paid for them. She told me to ask you.
er_v06_c18_b002_01: I brought some goods. This time I'm really here to sell.
er_v06_c18_b002_02: My mother gets up earlier than I do now. Two days ago I woke up and found her sitting there repairing an old tray.
er_v06_c18_b002_03: She says if her hands aren't doing something, she starts thinking about what happened in there.
er_v06_c18_b002_04: I handed her the tools and sat with her for a while.
er_v06_c18_b002_05: Nothing special. I just sat there for a while.
er_v06_c18_b004_01: I'll still come to sell goods. You don't have to ask me what happened every time.
er_v06_c18_b004_02: I'm a regular. Ordinary customers don't know what you buy.
er_v06_c19_b002_01: No goods today. There is something I want to tell you.
er_v06_c19_b002_02: You always ask what's for sale first. Don't ask today.
er_v06_c19_b002_03: I've been coming more often lately than when I had goods to sell.
er_v06_c19_b002_04: I wonder whether you found anything good today, whether your lunch has gone cold again, whether you argued with another difficult customer.
er_v06_c19_b002_05: Mother is safe now, and I still want to see you every day.
er_v06_c19_b002_07: Wait. Let me finish. I like you.
er_v06_c19_b002_08: There. Your turn. Don't keep me waiting.
er_v06_c19_b003_01: I like you too. It has nothing to do with where you used to live.
er_v06_c19_b003_02: Nothing to do with where I lived? Easy for you to say.
er_v06_c19_b003_03: Then when I needle you, don't dodge.
er_v06_c19_b003_04: Good. Then I won't need an excuse to come here anymore.
er_v06_c19_b005_01: I care about you. But not that way.
er_v06_c19_b005_03: You telling me directly is better than letting me guess.
er_v06_c19_b005_04: You don't owe me for the past. And this isn't repayment.
er_v06_c19_b005_05: I'll still come sell goods in a couple of days. Act normal then.
er_v06_c19_b006_01: I said some harsh things before. I want to add one thing today.
er_v06_c19_b006_02: Thank you for always treating me like someone who can do things for herself.
er_v06_c19_b006_03: I believe in myself now. If you ever need me for something, you can come find me too.
er_v06_c20_b002_01: Well? I picked well, didn't I?
er_v06_c20_b002_02: I didn't hide the flaws. Praise my eye, not my character.
er_v06_c20_b004_01: My mother says my tone when bargaining sounds more and more like yours.
er_v06_c20_b004_02: She says at least now I know what I'm talking about.
er_v06_c20_b004_03: I said the teacher is average. The student is the smart one.
er_v06_c20_b005_01: Isn't a clever girlfriend like me enough?
er_v06_c20_b005_02: You didn't argue with me this time. That counts as progress.
er_v06_c21_b001_01: Today I'm really here to buy something.
er_v06_c21_b001_02: Last time I also said a lot of things that weren't mine to decide for Eleanor.
er_v06_c21_b001_03: I apologized to her. She said don't just apologize to the owner. It makes it sound like she doesn't have a mouth of her own.
er_v06_c21_b001_04: I saw her mother. Thinner than before. Still talks the same way, won't let anyone praise her too much.
er_v06_c21_b001_05: Eleanor told me about recent events too. This time, I heard the whole story from beginning to end.
er_v06_c21_b002_01: I asked someone who knows about that bracelet. The price you offered was fair.
er_v06_c21_b002_02: Tell that to people upstairs and they won't believe there's a shopkeeper like that down here.
er_v06_c21_b003_01: Before, when we picked gifts, we only worried they weren't expensive enough.
er_v06_c21_b003_02: This time she told me to bring things that are actually useful, not turn a visit into an exhibition.
er_v06_c21_b003_03: She's right. It's the tone that makes it hard to admit right away.
er_v06_c21_b004_01: She told me you're together. I don't have conditions to set.
er_v06_c21_b004_02: When she said it, she wasn't planning to ask my opinion at all.
er_v06_c21_b004_03: Word going around up there is that Eleanor has taken a liking to a pawnshop owner in the lower levels.
er_v06_c21_b004_04: I deflected a few things for her. That was her trouble, not yours. Don't take it personally.
er_v06_c21_b005_01: She says you're a friend worth keeping. She rarely uses the word 'worth.'
er_v06_c21_b005_02: She's right. So is she. I didn't see it before.
er_v06_c21_b006_01: If suitable business comes up in the future, I'll have people come talk to you directly. You won't owe me a favour.
er_v06_c21_b006_02: If the goods are right and the price is right, we'll talk.
er_v06_c21_b006_03: No wonder she says that all the time now.
er_v06_c22_b002_01: Someone from the research side came to ask if we'd help organise the records my mother left behind.
er_v06_c22_b002_02: Some of the work is up there. It needs a separate work permit. It's not a return to our old life, and the case isn't closed.
er_v06_c22_b002_03: My mother wants to keep doing research. I want to understand the parts I couldn't follow.
er_v06_c22_b005_01: I'd like coming here to be more than being a regular customer.
er_v06_c22_b005_02: All right. I'll set aside the time. You have to set aside yours too.
er_v06_c22_b007_01: That time you asked the price, I didn't sell it. Do you remember?
er_v06_c22_b007_02: I told my mother I wanted to give it to you. She said it's mine, so I decide.
er_v06_c22_b007_03: It's not for sale. You'd better have learned the difference by now.
er_v06_c22_b008_01: Take it. Don't put it out with the stock. I'm not that generous.
er_v06_c22_b009_01: Fine, I'll wear it myself. You'll see it anyway.
er_v06_c23_b001_01: Hey. Are you free today? Not for any other reason today.
er_v06_c23_b001_02: My mother's fine, and I still have my job.
er_v06_c23_b001_03: You'll have to get used to it. I don't only show up when something's wrong.
er_v06_c23_b002_01: My mother keeps telling me to bring an extra portion of food.
er_v06_c23_b002_03: The room's small, so we count every credit. Mother still has nightmares.
er_v06_c23_b002_04: When she wakes up, I'm right there.
er_v06_c23_b002_05: What we have now isn't nothing.
er_v06_c23_b003_01: The first time I came here, I said this shop wasn't much. It still has plenty that needs fixing.
er_v06_c23_b003_02: Don't think that because I like you, I like the broken lights too. My temper doesn't disappear just because I'm in love.
er_v06_c23_b003_03: Let me stay a while today. If a customer comes, do your business.
er_v06_c23_b003_04: If no one comes, talk to me.
er_v06_c23_b003_05: Just don't start with 'how much more do you need?'
er_v06_rc_b001_01: The Nutrifruit research is at the newspaper. They said someone will review it before it runs.
er_v06_rc_b001_02: I told them about my mother too. They agreed to include the threats, but not to get her out.
er_v06_rc_b001_03: I'll keep asking about her and left an address where they can find me.
er_v06_rc_b001_04: You don't have to tell me we did the right thing.
er_v06_rc_b001_05: I just wanted someone to know that when I made the decision, I didn't forget her.
er_v06_rc_b002_01: The secret behind Pastel's nutrifruit has leaked! A research paper reveals how ordinary nutrifruit can be made to produce seeds again. The same morning, the former head of the station's largest hydroponics farm, imprisoned for embezzlement, was found dead in her cell. Pastel has declined to comment.
er_v06_rc_b002_03: The morning the paper came out, they killed my mother.
er_v06_rc_b002_04: I went to identify her. It wasn't a rumour.
er_v06_rc_b002_05: They said it was a sudden illness. On the very morning the paper came out.
er_v06_rc_b002_06: Don't tell me she would have wanted this. I can't ask her anymore.
er_v06_rc_b002_07: I know there were other ways. I know why I didn't choose them.
er_v06_rc_b002_08: But knowing that doesn't make this any easier.
er_v06_rc_b002_09: I want to stay here for a while. Don't ask me if I want a drink.
er_v06_rc_b003_01: They only returned a few of Mother's things.
er_v06_rc_b003_02: A list she wrote. All little things about the farm.
er_v06_rc_b003_03: Which light was broken, what tools were missing, which grow tank needed checking again.
er_v06_rc_b003_04: Not every page is research that could change the whole station.
er_v06_rc_b003_05: Most of the time, she was just busy with these things.
er_v06_rc_b003_06: I'm keeping this list. It's not for sale.
er_v06_rc_b004_01: Thank you. I'll take the food.
er_v06_rc_b004_02: Life has to go on. I know. Just not that fast.
er_v06_rc_b005_02: They approached me. But in the end, I went to them myself.
er_v06_rc_b005_03: They'll help me make Pastel pay, and they can keep me out of the company's reach. The research can keep spreading too.
er_v06_rc_b005_04: I asked what they're going to do. I won't agree to anything just because someone promises revenge for me.
er_v06_rc_b005_05: I won't stay in the same place. I can't come here on a fixed schedule anymore.
er_v06_rc_b005_06: I won't use your shop as a contact point. You helped me. That doesn't mean you should carry every risk from now on.
er_v06_rc_b005_07: Sometimes, though, I might still need someone I can have an ordinary conversation with.
er_v06_rc_b005_08: Of course I know where this place is.
er_v06_rc_b006_01: All right, I need a weapon. What do you have?
er_v06_rc_b006_02: Someone's teaching me. I'm not going to wave around something I can't use just to frighten people.
er_v06_rc_b006_03: I'll check the condition first. I don't want anything broken.
er_v06_rc_b007_01: I have enough money. Don't waive this one for me.
er_v06_rc_b008_01: Then I'll look elsewhere. I'm not in a hurry to take something more likely to hurt me.
er_v06_rc_b009_01: Before, all I wanted was to go back to how things were.
er_v06_rc_b009_02: Now I can't even say what I want to become.
er_v06_rc_b009_03: Don't take anyone's word too seriously. Including mine.
er_v06_rc_b010_01: I'm looking for Eleanor. But she said not to ask around about where she lives.
er_v06_rc_b010_02: I won't ask around. I'm not here to take her back, and I know how bad that would sound right now.
er_v06_rc_b010_03: I just want to explain what her mother did for my family before. Back then, I did nothing for her.
er_v06_rc_b010_04: When she's ready to listen, I'll tell her myself.
er_v06_rc_b010_05: If she needs something normal that can be bought, I can help find it. I don't need to know where she goes.
er_v06_rc_b010_06: Please pass that on to her.
er_v06_rc_b011_02: Later. I don't have the energy to teach everyone how to talk to me right now.
er_v06_rc_b012_01: I know there are things between us we never finished saying.
er_v06_rc_b012_02: I care about you. That didn't disappear because something happened to my mother.
er_v06_rc_b012_03: But I can't promise to come back on time, and I can't ask you to stop your life and wait for me.
er_v06_rc_b012_04: When I can come back, I will. I can't promise anything else right now.
er_v06_rc_b013_01: I'll remember this place. Not just the research and the investigator's money.
er_v06_rc_b013_02: I also remember the first time I turned my nose up at your cup. It really was chipped. I wasn't wrong about that.
er_v06_rc_b014_01: I'm here for food for the road. We're leaving with the revolutionaries soon.
er_v06_rc_b014_02: Nutrifruit too. Seeing it now makes me feel that at least some things weren't for nothing.
er_v06_rc_b014_03: Pick out what I can carry. I'll pay the usual price.
er_v06_rc_b015_02: Take care of yourself. Don't take in every bit of trouble that comes to your door.
er_v06_rc_b015_03: Thank you again. For everything. I hope next time we can talk about something else.
er_v06_rd_b001_02: I handed it over. They promised to release her, no confirmation. I took the three hundred.
er_v06_rd_b001_03: I asked you to keep it, not to decide what my mother is worth for me.
er_v06_rd_b001_04: Don't tell me it can still be fixed. I'll find out myself. From today, keep out of my business.
er_v06_rd_b004_01: That thing in the newspaper. You sent it, didn't you?
er_v06_rd_b004_02: But it shouldn't have been you! What gave you the right to decide, behind my back, what my mother would have to pay?
er_v06_rd_b004_03: You can say someone had to decide. But don't tell me this was a road we chose together.
er_v06_rd_b005_01: I've thought about it. I'll handle what comes next myself.
er_v06_rd_b005_02: First I'll find a way to get my mother back. I'll ask about every condition they've set, one by one.
er_v06_rd_b005_03: You helped me before. Thank you. Even if we didn't make it to the end, I won't forget that.
er_v06_ep_b002_01: Mother made too much. She told me to bring you some.
er_v06_ep_b002_02: Take it. Don't ask why there's always exactly one extra portion.
er_v06_ep_b002_03: Ask too much and the cook won't know what to say. Eat.
er_v06_ep_b003_01: I knew that customer just now. He used to tell me not to associate with people down here.
er_v06_ep_b003_02: I told him: if you want to buy something, follow the rules here. If you want to teach me how to pick a boyfriend, please leave.
er_v06_ep_b003_03: He bought something in the end. So he's not always that tactless.
er_v06_ep_b005_01: I sorted this batch. The bad ones are together. Don't say I didn't warn you.
er_v06_ep_b005_02: I'm an old hand now. Don't bring up my first scavenging trip again.
er_v06_ep_b005_03: All right, let's talk about today's price first.
er_v06_ep_b006_01: Let's not talk about all that today. Got anything new in the shop?
er_v06_ep_b006_02: Goods, not news. Preferably the kind where I can find a few things wrong.
er_v06_ep_b006_03: Good. Sounds like an ordinary trip to the shop.
er_v06_c04_b004_01: *tells her about the man claiming to be her uncle*
er_v06_c04_b004_02: My uncle? I don't have an uncle.
er_v06_c04_b004_03: I told you. Apart from my mother, I don't have any family.
er_v06_c05_b001_02: My money's gone. Someone broke in last night and took what was left.
er_v06_c05_b001_03: Only this locket survived. I was wearing it.
er_v06_c05_b001_04: I wasn't there. My roommate went to ask around. No word yet.

er_v06_c03_n002_06: This is mine. I'll bring it out when I've decided.
er_v06_c03_n003_01: The shopkeeper flips the scale pan over on the counter and leaves it there.
er_v06_c03_n003_02: You're not even going to name a price?
er_v06_c03_n004_01: He names a price. She listens, then tucks the pendant back under her collar.
er_v06_c03_n004_02: ...The price is fair. But it's not for sale.
er_v06_c03_n005_01: Never mind. ...If I really bring it next time, don't play the big spender.
er_v06_c03_n005_02: I'm going. I'll watch what I spend.
er_v06_c04_n001_01: No customers that afternoon. A man comes in carrying a gift box, ribboned and dusted with grey.
er_v06_c04_n001_02: Hello there. You know Eleanor, don't you? I'm her... uncle.
er_v06_c04_n001_03: We prepared a little gift for her. Only the best from the upper district.
er_v06_c04_n001_04: But I can't find her anywhere.
er_v06_c04_n001_05: Young people get upset and hide. I hear she comes here often.
er_v06_c04_n001_06: Next time she visits, could you give this to her?
er_v06_c04_n001_07: Make sure it reaches her hands. Not yours. Hers.
er_v06_c04_n001_08: If anyone asks, you never saw me.
er_v06_c04_n001_09: Oh, and keep Security out of this. It's a family matter.
er_v06_c04_n001_10: He pushes the box across the counter, one ribbon end hanging over the edge.
er_v06_c04_n003_01: The box sits under the counter overnight. At the next count, a serial number shows on its base.
er_v06_c04_n003_02: Upper-level farm goods reported stolen. Serial logged. Anyone who finds them should report it.
er_v06_c04_n002_01: Register? I'm delivering a gift to her, and you want paperwork?
er_v06_c04_n002_02: It's a family matter. Don't ask.
er_v06_c04_n002_04: Then I'll leave it here. When she comes, you'll give it to her.
er_v06_c04_n002_05: The door closes. Under the box is a farm-goods serial tag, its corner torn.
er_v06_c04_n002_06: Upper-level farm goods reported stolen. Serial logged. Anyone who finds them should report it.
er_v06_c04_n004_01: Forget it, then. I'll take the box back.
er_v06_c04_n004_02: He pulls the box back into his arms, ribbon hanging over his elbow. The door closes.
er_v06_c04_n005_01: The patrol officer arrives quickly, mist still on his cap brim.
er_v06_c04_n005_03: There's a farm serial on the base. The notice says stolen.
er_v06_c04_n005_04: I'll take the goods back. I've logged the serial.
er_v06_c04_n005_05: Has she touched the box? If she has, tell her to come in tomorrow.
er_v06_c04_n005_07: Procedure still requires a word with her.
er_v06_c04_n005_08: The box is tucked under his arm and carried out, the ribbon trailing across the door frame.
er_v06_c04_n006_01: The next day she comes later than usual, half-dried mud on her shoes.
er_v06_c04_n006_02: Security knocked on my door this morning.
er_v06_c04_n006_03: Someone left me a box. One that's been reported stolen.
er_v06_c04_n006_04: My uncle? I don't have an uncle.
er_v06_c04_n006_05: I told you. Apart from my mother, I don't have any family.
er_v06_c04_n006_06: They wanted me arrested. Just like my mother.
er_v06_c04_n006_07: She's already locked up in there. Isn't that enough for them?
er_v06_c04_n006_08: She grips the edge of the counter, fingers digging into the seam, back straight.
er_v06_c04_n006_10: There was a serial on the base. The notice said stolen.
er_v06_c04_n006_11: ...You were right to report it. But next time, don't decide for me.
er_v06_c04_n006_13: Before, if someone sent me a crate like that, I wouldn't even check the label. I'd just open it.
er_v06_c04_n007_01: You warned me. Take this. It's the last thing I brought from home.
er_v06_c04_n008_01: She stops at the door, glances back at the counter, then pushes it open and leaves.
er_v06_c05_n001_02: She stands outside for a long time before pushing the door open a crack.
er_v06_c05_n001_04: The money's gone. What's left empties out after rent.
er_v06_c05_n001_05: Only this pendant left, and I've kept it on.
er_v06_c05_n001_06: I can't believe I'm about to ask this.
er_v06_c05_n001_07: But could you spare me some food? Anything edible.
er_v06_c05_n002_01: The bag on the counter is opened. Dried food and two nutrifruits are pushed toward her.
er_v06_c05_n002_04: She presses the dried food against her chest, eyes falling on the two nutrifruits.
er_v06_c05_n002_05: Put it on the ledger. I'll pay it back.
er_v06_c05_n002_06: My roommate split her share with me yesterday.
er_v06_c05_n002_07: The first day I came here, I called you all frogs in a well. Said lower-level people live like this forever.
er_v06_c05_n002_08: I was wrong to say that.
er_v06_c05_n002_09: The nutrifruits go into her inner pocket. She fastens the button, twice, before it catches.
er_v06_c05_n002_12: She reaches the door, pauses with her hand on the handle, then pushes it open.
er_v06_c05_n003_01: He doesn't touch the bag on the counter.
er_v06_c05_n003_02: How much clearer do I need to be? The money's gone, rent's due, the pendant stays.
er_v06_c05_n003_03: She finishes and keeps her hand on the counter.
er_v06_c05_n004_01: He asks a few questions. She repeats what she can still stand to say.
er_v06_c05_n004_03: I understand. You run a shop, not a relief station.
er_v06_c05_n004_04: She folds the empty cloth bag and tucks it back into her jacket.
er_v06_c05_n004_06: I came here. That stays quiet too.
er_v06_c05_n004_07: She pushes the door open and leaves.
er_v06_c05_n005_01: (Get something to eat out, or let her finish first.)
